shared.tagline.en: Know the wait before you walk in.

shared.footer.copyright.en: © 2026 PickupRadar. Independent and not affiliated with Uber Eats, Deliveroo or Just Eat.
shared.footer.copyright.text: © 2026 PickupRadar. Yetongodde, era tekwatagana na Uber Eats, Deliveroo oba Just Eat.

shared.scale.estimate.en: No recent reports? PickupRadar may show {likelyFast} or {likelySlow}:
shared.scale.estimate.text: Tewali lipoota mpya? PickupRadar eyinza okulaga {likelyFast} oba {likelySlow}:

home.meta.title.en: PickupRadar (Pickup Radar): pickup wait times for delivery drivers in the UK
home.meta.title.text: PickupRadar (Pickup Radar): obudde bw'okulinda okw'okuyingiza eri ba draywa mu Bungereza

home.meta.description.en: See how long drivers wait at restaurants and shops before you go in. For Uber Eats, Deliveroo and Just Eat drivers in the UK. No sign-up needed.
home.meta.description.text: Laba ba draywa balinda bbanga ki mu marestaulo n'amadduuka nga tonnayigga. Eri ba draywa ba Uber Eats, Deliveroo ne Just Eat mu Bungereza. Tewali kweyungako.

home.meta.imageAlt.en: PickupRadar. Know the wait before you walk in.
home.meta.imageAlt.text: PickupRadar. Manya obudde bw'okulinda nga tonnayigga.

home.hero.lede.en: Do you deliver for Uber Eats, Deliveroo or Just Eat? See recent pickup waits at restaurants and shops. Avoid long waits. Tap {reportWait} and earn {radarPoints}. No sign-up needed.
home.hero.lede.text: Otuusa Uber Eats, Deliveroo oba Just Eat? Laba obudde obupya obw'okulinda ku bifo eby'okuyingiza ebya marestaulo n'amadduuka. Weewale okulinda okwanvu. Nyiga {reportWait} ofune {radarPoints}. Tewali kweyungako.

home.hero.cities.en: Now in Milton Keynes. London is next.
home.hero.cities.text: Kati mu Milton Keynes. Eddako London.

home.hero.apps.en: The iPhone and Android apps are coming soon.
home.hero.apps.text: App za iPhone ne Android zijja mangu.

home.example.aria.en: Example PickupRadar Home screen with the {nearby} tab open, showing pickup points coloured by their wait
home.example.aria.text: Ekyokulabirako ky'olutimbe lw'ewaka lwa PickupRadar nga tabu {nearby} eggule. Ebifo eby'okuyingiza bilina langi okusinziira ku budde bw'okulinda

home.example.banner.en: Example screen: sample waits, not live driver reports
home.example.banner.text: Lutimbe lw'ekyokulabirako: budde bw'okulinda obw'ekyokulabirako, si lipoota ya draywa ey'obulamu

home.example.caption.en: Example screen. These are sample wait times, not live reports. {live} with real data.
home.example.caption.text: Lutimbe lw'ekyokulabirako. Buno budde bw'okulinda obw'ekyokulabirako, si lipoota y'obulamu. {live} n'ebikwata ku bituufu.

home.try.tab.en: {lead} Use {nearby} to find pickup points close to you when location is on. Use {fast} and {slow} to check waits and estimates.
home.try.tab.text: {lead} Kozesa {nearby} okunoonya ebifo eby'okuyingiza ebiri okumpi naawe nga ekifo kiri ku. Kozesa {fast} ne {slow} okukebera obudde bw'okulinda n'okuteebereza.

home.try.search.en: {lead} Try a name, area or postcode, like KFC or Bletchley.
home.try.search.text: {lead} Gezaako erinnya, ekitundu oba koodi ya poosita, ng'ekyokulabirako KFC oba Bletchley.

home.try.open.en: {lead} The {reportWait} screen opens. Choose a wait time. Nothing is sent.
home.try.open.text: {lead} Olutimbe {reportWait} lugulawo. Londa obudde bw'okulinda. Tewali kintu kigenda.

home.signals.title.en: What you can see before you go in

home.signals.intro.en: You see the same labels in the app. Drivers report them, not the delivery apps.
home.signals.intro.text: Olaba ebipande by'emu mu app. Ba draywa be babiraga, si app y'okutuusa.

home.signals.current.body.en: Drivers choose a wait time. You see the current wait and how many drivers reported it in the last 2 hours.
home.signals.current.body.text: Ba draywa balonda obudde bw'okulinda. Olaba obudde bw'okulinda obwa kati n'omuwendo gwa ba draywa ababuloopye mu ssaawa 2 eziyise.

home.signals.likely.body.en: Shown only when there are no recent reports. These are estimates, not live reports.
home.signals.likely.body.text: Kiragibwa lwokka nga tewali lipoota mpya. Kino kuteebereza, si lipoota y'obulamu.

home.signals.closed.pill.text: Kyaloopeddwa buli lwa ggulo nti kiggaddwa

home.signals.closed.body.en: Drivers tap {reportProblem} to report this. You see their report before you drive there.
home.signals.closed.body.text: Ba draywa banyiga {reportProblem} okuloopa kino. Olaba lipoota nga tonnagenda eyo.

home.how.intro.en: Three easy steps. Reporting takes a few seconds.
home.how.intro.text: Emitendera esatu emangu. Okuloopa kutwala butikiti butono.

home.how.step1.body.en: No password. The app gives you a Radar profile automatically. You don't need to sign up.
home.how.step1.body.text: Tewali kkoodi. App ekuwa purofayiro ya Radar yokka. Toyetaaga kweyunga.

home.how.step2.body.en: Find the pickup point. See the current wait, or {likelyFast} or {likelySlow} if there are no recent reports.
home.how.step2.body.text: Noonya ekifo ky'okuyingiza. Laba obudde bw'okulinda obwa kati, oba {likelyFast} oba {likelySlow} nga tewali lipoota mpya.

home.how.step3.body.en: After you collect the order, tap {reportWait}. It takes seconds. Your report helps other drivers, and you earn {radarPoints}.
home.how.step3.body.text: Oluvannyuma lw'okutwala ooda, nyiga {reportWait}. Kutwala butikiti butono. Lipoota yo eyamba ba draywa abalala, era ofuna {radarPoints}.

home.points.neededHelp.en: An eligible pickup point near you with no recent wait and no {likelyFast} or {likelySlow}. You earn 15 RP for the report instead of 10.
home.points.neededHelp.text: Ekifo ky'okuyingiza ekituukiridde okumpi naawe, tewali budde bupya obw'okulinda, era tewali {likelyFast} oba {likelySlow}. Ofuna 15 RP ku lipoota eyo, si 10.

home.cities.body.en: These are the UK cities in the app. Can't find your city? Request it in the app. Or tap {notify} on a {comingSoon} city. We'll email you when it's live.
home.cities.body.text: Zino bibuga bya Bungereza mu app. Tolaba kibuga kyo? Kisabe mu app. Oba nyiga {notify} ku kibuga ekiri {comingSoon}. Tukuwandiikira email bwe kiba kiramu.

home.trust.title.en: Not part of any delivery app
home.trust.title.text: Si kitundu kya app y'okutuusa yonna

home.trust.body.en: PickupRadar is independent. It is not part of Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat or any other delivery app. It never uses your accounts with them.
home.trust.body.text: PickupRadar yetongodde. Si kitundu kya Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat oba app y'okutuusa endala yonna. Teyita akawunti yo eyo.

home.trust.login.en: {lead} We never ask for your Uber Eats, Deliveroo or Just Eat username or password.
home.trust.login.text: {lead} Tetusaba linnya oba kkoodi ya Uber Eats, Deliveroo oba Just Eat.

home.trust.detailsLead.text: Tewali bikwata ku kasitoma oba ku ooda.

home.trust.details.en: {lead} No names, addresses or order numbers.
home.trust.details.text: {lead} Tewali linnya, endagiriro oba ennamba y'ooda.

home.faq.account.a.en: No. The app gives you a Radar profile automatically. You can report waits straight away. To protect your {radarPoints}, add your email later. No password needed. The app emails you a 6-digit code.
home.faq.account.a.text: Nedda. App ekuwa purofayiro ya Radar yokka. Oyinza okuloopa obudde bw'okulinda amangu. Okukuuma {radarPoints}, yongerako email oluvannyuma. Tewali kkoodi. App eweereza kkoodi ey'ennamba 6 ku email.

home.faq.download.q.en: When can I download the app?

home.faq.download.a.en: The iPhone and Android apps are coming soon. For now, the {preview} shows real Milton Keynes pickup points and waits.
home.faq.download.a.text: App za iPhone ne Android zijja mangu. Mu kiseera kino, {preview} eraga ebifo eby'okuyingiza ebya ddala n'obudde bw'okulinda mu Milton Keynes.

home.faq.track.a.en: No background tracking. The app uses your location while you use it, to show nearby pickup points and check you are at a pickup point when reporting. The website asks for location only when you choose to use it. Read the {privacy} for more.
home.faq.track.a.text: Tewali kugoberera mu bwaliri. App ekozesa ekifo kyo nga okozesa, okulaga ebifo eby'okuyingiza ebiri okumpi n'okukebera nti oli ku kifo ky'okuyingiza nga oloopa. Kagali kasaba kifo lwokka ng'olondedde okukozesa. Soma {privacy} okumanya ebisingawo.

app.meta.description.en: Try the PickupRadar app with real Milton Keynes data. Look around, search for pickup points and see the report screen.
app.meta.description.text: Gezaako app ya PickupRadar n'ebikwata ku bituufu ebya Milton Keynes. Laba wabweru, noonya ekifo ky'okuyingiza era olabe olutimbe lw'okuloopa.

app.hero.lede.en: This is PickupRadar with real Milton Keynes data. Look around. Search for a pickup point and open it. Nothing you tap here is sent. You can only report in the mobile app.
app.hero.lede.text: Guno gwe PickupRadar n'ebikwata ku bituufu ebya Milton Keynes. Laba wabweru. Noonya ekifo ky'okuyingiza ogulawo. Kyonna ky'onyiga wano tekigenda. Oyinza okuloopa mu app y'essimu lwokka.

app.preview.aria.en: Full PickupRadar app preview with real Milton Keynes data
app.preview.aria.text: Okulaba kwonna kw'app ya PickupRadar n'ebikwata ku bituufu ebya Milton Keynes

support.meta.description.en: Get help with PickupRadar: contact support, report a pickup point problem, and find answers about your Radar profile, {radarPoints} and deleting your account.
support.meta.description.text: Obuyambi bwa PickupRadar: tuukirira obuyambi, loopa obuzibu bw'ekifo ky'okuyingiza, era noonya eby'okuddamu ku purofayiro ya Radar, {radarPoints} n'okusangula akawunti.

support.hero.lede.en: Need help? Email us about the app, a pickup point, your {radarPoints} or your privacy.
support.hero.lede.text: Weetaaga obuyambi? Tuwandiikire email ku app, ekifo ky'okuyingiza, {radarPoints} oba ebyekyama byo.

support.contact.body.en: Email us for help, ideas, pickup point problems or privacy questions:
support.contact.body.text: Tuwandiikire email olw'obuyambi, endowooza, obuzibu bw'ekifo ky'okuyingiza oba ekibuuzo ky'ebyekyama:

support.address.note.en: For letters only. Email is the fastest way to reach us.
support.address.note.text: Ku mbaluwa zokka. Email y'engeri esinga okwangu okututuukirira.

support.include.body.en: If you report a problem, please tell us:

support.include.area.en: The area or postcode, if you know it
support.include.area.text: Ekitundu oba koodi ya poosita, bw'oba ng'omanyi

support.include.phone.en: Your phone model, if the app has a problem
support.include.phone.text: Ekika ky'essimu yo, obuzibu bw'aba mu app

support.topics.profile.body.en: The app gives you a Radar profile automatically. You do not need to log in to use PickupRadar or earn {radarPoints}. Adding your email is optional. It protects your {radarPoints} if you change or reset your phone. No password needed. The app emails you a 6-digit code.
support.topics.profile.body.text: App ekuwa purofayiro ya Radar yokka. Toyetaaga kuyingira okukozesa PickupRadar oba okufuna {radarPoints}. Okwongerako email ky'oyagala. Kikuuma {radarPoints} bw'okyusa oba nga oddiza essimu. Tewali kkoodi. App eweereza kkoodi ey'ennamba 6 ku email.

support.topics.points.body.en: You earn {radarPoints} for valid wait reports ({waitRp}, or {neededRp} when it says {reportNeeded}), a first report bonus ({firstRp}) and pickup points we approve ({approvedRp}). You can invite a driver from {profile}. You both need protected Radar accounts (add your email). Your friend enters your code before their first valid wait report. When your friend makes 3 valid wait reports, on at least 2 different days (UTC time), at 2 different pickup points, you each earn {referralRp}. {rewards} You can't redeem {radarPoints} yet.
support.topics.points.body.text: Ofuna {radarPoints} ku lipoota entuufu ey'okulinda ({waitRp}, oba {neededRp} nga {reportNeeded} ewandiikiddwa), ensimbi ez'okwongerako ku lipoota esooka ({firstRp}) n'ekifo ky'okuyingiza kye tukkiriza ({approvedRp}). Oyinza okuyita draywa okuva ku {profile}. Mmwe bombi mwetaaga akawunti za Radar ezikuumiddwa (yongerako email). Mukwano gwo ateeka kkoodi yo nga tannakola lipoota esooka entuufu ey'okulinda. Mukwano gwo bw'akola lipoota 3 entuufu ez'okulinda, ku nnaku ez'enjawulo waakiri 2 (essaawa ya UTC), ku bifo eby'okuyingiza eby'enjawulo 2, buli omu afuna {referralRp}. {rewards} Tonyinza kukozesa {radarPoints} kati.

support.topics.messages.body.en: {profile} has {messages}: announcements, alerts and personal messages for your city or Radar profile. Old or removed messages may no longer appear.
support.topics.messages.body.text: {profile} erina {messages}: ebilango, okubuulirira n'obubaka obw'omuntu ku kibuga kyo oba purofayiro ya Radar. Obubaka obukadde oba obwaggiddwawo buyinza obutaddayo kulabika.

support.topics.delete.body.en: Delete your account in the app: {profile} → {deleteAccount}. Or email {email}. If you did not add an email, the app shows {deleteProfile} instead. See the {page} page for the steps.
support.topics.delete.body.text: Sangula akawunti mu app: {profile} → {deleteAccount}. Oba tuwandiikire {email}. Bw'oba tonnayongerako email, app eraga {deleteProfile}. Laba olupapula {page} okumanya emitendera.

support.topics.missing.body.en: Is a pickup point missing? Tap {suggest} in the app. Is one wrong? Tap {reportProblem}. Or email us and we will check it.
support.topics.missing.body.text: Ekifo ky'okuyingiza tekiriwo? Nyiga {suggest} mu app. Waliwo ekikyamu? Nyiga {reportProblem}. Oba tuwandiikire, tujja kulaba.

support.topics.delivery.body.en: PickupRadar does not connect to your Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat or other delivery app accounts. We never ask for your delivery app logins, passwords, account details, customer details or order details. Drivers only share pickup reports, like wait times and pickup point problems.
support.topics.delivery.body.text: PickupRadar tekwatagana na kawunti yo eya Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat oba app y'okutuusa endala yonna. Tetusaba kuyingira, kkoodi, ebikwata ku kawunti, ebikwata ku kasitoma oba ebikwata ku ooda. Ba draywa bagabana lipoota z'okuyingiza zokka, ng'obudde bw'okulinda n'obuzibu bw'ekifo ky'okuyingiza.

support.closer.title.en: Try PickupRadar before the app launches.

support.closer.body.en: The live preview shows real Milton Keynes pickup points and waits. Reporting and {radarPoints} are only in the mobile app.
support.closer.body.text: Okulaba obulamu kulaga ebifo eby'okuyingiza ebya ddala n'obudde bw'okulinda mu Milton Keynes. Okuloopa ne {radarPoints} biri mu app y'essimu lwokka.

notfound.meta.description.en: That page is not on the PickupRadar website.
notfound.meta.description.text: Olupapula olwo teruli ku kagali ka PickupRadar.

notfound.title.en: This page is off the radar.
notfound.title.text: Olupapula luno luli wabweru wa radar.

notfound.body.en: That address isn't on the PickupRadar website. These pages are:
notfound.body.text: Endagiriro eyo teruli ku kagali ka PickupRadar. Empapula zino ziriwo:

privacy.notice.en: The summary and section headings are translated. The full privacy policy is in English, which is the official version.
privacy.notice.text: Mu bufunze n'emitwe gy'ebitundu bivvuunuddwa. Enkola y'ebyama enzijuvu eri mu Lungereza, era enkyusa y'Olungereza y'ey'obuyinza.

privacy.h.collect.en: Information we collect and how we use it

privacy.h.share.text: Abo be tugabana nabo ebikwata ku bantu

privacy.h.transfers.text: Okusindika ebikwata ku bantu ebweru w'eggwanga

privacy.h.retention.text: Bbanga ki lye tutereka ebikwata ku bantu

privacy.sum.what.en: PickupRadar helps delivery drivers see and report pickup wait times and venue problems.
privacy.sum.what.text: PickupRadar eyamba abavuzi abatwala ebintu okulaba n'okuloopa ebbanga ly'okulinda nga banona ebyaguliddwa n'ebizibu by'ebifo.

privacy.sum.account.en: You can browse without creating an account. The app creates an anonymous Radar profile for your phone, and an email account is optional.
privacy.sum.account.text: Osobola okulambula awatali akawunti. App ekola pulofayiro ya Radar etaliiko linnya ku ssimu yo, era akawunti ya imeeyilo si ya buwaze.

privacy.sum.location.en: If you allow location, the app uses it while you are using it: to sort nearby pickup points, detect your city and check that you are at a venue when you submit a live report. We do not save your location with your reports.
privacy.sum.location.text: Bw'okkiriza ekifo, app ekikozesa kyokka ng'ogikozesa: okusengeka ebifo eby'okunona ebiri okumpi, okumanya ekibuga kyo, n'okukakasa nti oli mu kifo ng'oweereza alipoota ey'akaseera kano. Tetutereka kifo kyo wamu ne alipoota zo.

privacy.sum.saved.en: Your saved pickup points stay on your phone.
privacy.sum.saved.text: Ebifo eby'okunona by'otereseeko bisigala ku ssimu yo.

privacy.sum.noSale.en: We do not sell your personal information and the app contains no advertising or analytics trackers.
privacy.sum.noSale.text: Tetutunda bikukwatako, era app terina bikulondoola bya kulanga oba okwekenneenya.

privacy.sum.delete.en: You can delete your Radar profile or account in the app, or ask us by email. See {link}.
privacy.sum.delete.text: Osobola okusazaamu pulofayiro yo eya Radar oba akawunti mu app, oba n'otusaba ku imeeyilo. Laba {link}.

delete.meta.title.en: Delete your account or data — PickupRadar
delete.meta.title.text: Sazaamu akawunti yo oba ebikukwatako — PickupRadar

delete.meta.description.en: How to delete your PickupRadar account, Radar profile and associated data, including without the app.
delete.meta.description.text: Engeri y'okusazaamu akawunti ya PickupRadar, pulofayiro ya Radar n'ebibakwatako, ne bw'oba toli na app.

delete.lead.en: This page explains how to delete your PickupRadar account, your Radar profile and the data linked to them, including if you no longer have the app. PickupRadar is developed by Hamza Khan.
delete.lead.text: Olupapula luno lunnyonnyola engeri y'okusazaamu akawunti yo eya PickupRadar, pulofayiro yo eya Radar n'ebibakwatako, ne bw'oba tokyalina app. PickupRadar yakolebwa Hamza Khan.

delete.app.step2.en: Tap {profile} at the bottom of the Home screen.

delete.app.step3.en: Scroll down and tap {deleteAccount} if you protected your RadarPoints with your email, or {deleteProfile} if you did not.
delete.app.step3.text: Seeteeza wansi onyige {deleteAccount} bw'oba wakuuma RadarPoints zo ne imeeyilo, oba {deleteProfile} bw'oba tewakikola.

delete.app.after.en: Deletion starts straight away. Afterwards, the app starts a new anonymous Radar profile on your phone.
delete.app.after.text: Okusazaamu kutandika amangu ddala. Oluvannyuma app etandika pulofayiro ya Radar empya etaliiko linnya ku ssimu yo.

delete.email.title.en: Ask us to delete your email account
delete.email.title.text: Tusabe okusazaamu akawunti yo eya imeeyilo

delete.email.intro.en: If you protected your RadarPoints with your email address and cannot use the app:
delete.email.intro.text: Bw'oba wakuuma RadarPoints zo n'endagiriro ya imeeyilo era nga tosobola kukozesa app:

delete.email.step1.text: Weereza imeeyilo ku {email} {from}, ng'omutwe gwayo gwe “{subject}”.

delete.email.from.en: from the email address on your PickupRadar account
delete.email.from.text: okuva ku ndagiriro ya imeeyilo eya akawunti yo eya PickupRadar

delete.email.step2.en: We will reply to that address to confirm the request before deleting anything.
delete.email.step2.text: Tujja kuddamu ku ndagiriro eyo okukakasa okusaba nga tetunnasazaamu kintu kyonna.

delete.email.other.en: If you write from a different address, we will need to confirm that you control the account’s email address. We will never ask for a password or for a sign-in code. Do not send us your code.
delete.email.other.text: Bw'owandiika okuva ku ndagiriro endala, tujja kwetaaga okukakasa nti ggwe afuga endagiriro ya imeeyilo eya akawunti. Tetujja kukusaba kigambo kya kyama oba koodi y'okuyingira. Totuweereza koodi yo.

delete.anon.p1.en: If you never added an email address, your Radar profile is linked only to a random ID stored in the app on your phone. The easiest way to delete it is in the app, using the steps above.
delete.anon.p1.text: Bw'oba tewayongerako ndagiriro ya imeeyilo, pulofayiro yo eya Radar ekwataganyizibwa ne ID ey'akavuyo yokka eterekeddwa mu app ku ssimu yo. Engeri ennyangu ey'okugisazaamu eri mu app, ng'ogoberera emitendera egiri waggulu.

delete.anon.p2.en: Deleting the app removes that ID from your phone, but it does {not} delete the records on our servers.
delete.anon.p2.text: Okusazaamu app kuggyawo ID eyo ku ssimu yo, naye {not} ebiwandiiko ebiri ku seeva zaffe.

delete.anon.p3.en: Ownership of an anonymous profile can only be proven from the phone it was created on, using the random ID and secret code stored in the app. Details such as a Radar name, a city or the dates you used the app can’t prove that a profile is yours, because other people could know them. So if you no longer have the app, we may not be able to delete an anonymous profile. You can still email {email} and we will explain what we can do.
delete.anon.p3.text: Obwannannyini bwa pulofayiro etaliiko linnya busobola okukakasibwa okuva ku ssimu kwe yakolerwa yokka, nga okozesa ID ey'akavuyo ne koodi ey'ekyama eziterekeddwa mu app. Ebikwata ng'erinnya lya Radar, ekibuga oba ennaku z'okozesezzaamu app tebikakasa nti pulofayiro yiyo, kubanga n'abalala bayinza okubimanya. N'olwekyo bw'oba tokyalina app, tuyinza obutasobola kusazaamu pulofayiro etaliiko linnya. Naye osobola okuweereza imeeyilo ku {email} tukunnyonnyole kye tusobola okukola.

delete.alerts.body.en: You can withdraw a launch alert in the app, or email us from the address you signed up with and we will delete the sign-ups for that address. Launch-alert emails are also deleted automatically, as explained in our {privacy}.
delete.alerts.body.text: Osobola okuggyawo okumanyisa okutandika mu app, oba n'otuweereza imeeyilo okuva ku ndagiriro gye weewandiisizaako ne tusazaamu okwewandiisa kw'endagiriro eyo. Imeeyilo z'okumanyisa okutandika nazo zisazibwamu zokka, nga {privacy} yaffe bw'ennyonnyola.

delete.deleted.profile.en: Your Radar profile, Radar name, RadarPoints and contribution history
delete.deleted.profile.text: Pulofayiro yo eya Radar, erinnya lya Radar, RadarPoints n'ebyafaayo by'ebyo by'owaddeyo

delete.deleted.email.en: Your email sign-in, if you had an email account
delete.deleted.email.text: Okuyingira kwo ne imeeyilo, bw'oba wali na akawunti ya imeeyilo

delete.deleted.links.en: The links between your phone’s device ID and your profile
delete.deleted.links.text: Enkolagana wakati wa ID y'ekyuma ky'essimu yo ne pulofayiro yo

delete.deleted.referrals.en: Your referral codes, and your read or dismissed status for in-app messages
delete.deleted.referrals.text: Koodi zo ez'okuyita abalala, n'embeera y'obubaka bwa app obusomeddwa oba obuggaddwa

delete.deleted.alerts.en: City launch alert sign-ups linked to your profile or phone
delete.deleted.alerts.text: Okwewandiisa okw'okumanyisa okutandika okukwataganyizibwa ne pulofayiro yo oba essimu

delete.deleted.notes.en: Notes on the problem reports, status reports and venue suggestions linked to your profile
delete.deleted.notes.text: Ebiwandiiko ku alipoota z'ebizibu, alipoota z'embeera n'ebiteeso by'ebifo ebikwataganyizibwa ne pulofayiro yo

delete.kept.reports.en: {lead}, such as wait times, venue status reports and tags, and venue suggestions: the device ID on the records linked to your profile is replaced with a random value, so they are no longer connected to your profile in our database. They still contain details such as the venue and time, so they are de-identified rather than fully anonymous. They may be kept so they can still help other drivers.
delete.kept.reports.text: {lead}, ng'ebbanga ly'okulinda, alipoota z'embeera n'obubonero bw'ebifo, n'ebiteeso by'ebifo: ID y'ekyuma mu biwandiiko ebikwataganyizibwa ne pulofayiro yo ekyusibwamu omuwendo ogw'akavuyo, bwe kityo mu tterekero lyaffe tebikyakwataganyizibwa ne pulofayiro yo. Bikyalimu ebikwata ng'ekifo n'obudde, n'olwekyo biggyiddwamu ebimanyisa omuntu, naye tebiri nga ebitaliiko linnya ddala. Biyinza okukuumibwa bisobole okweyongera okuyamba abavuzi abalala.

delete.kept.referrals.en: {lead} that involved you, without your profile.

delete.kept.receipt.en: {lead} for email accounts (an internal account reference, the device ID, a one-way scrambled copy of the phone’s secret code and dates), so the deletion can be completed safely and shown to have happened.
delete.kept.receipt.text: {lead} ku akawunti za imeeyilo (ekijuliziddwa eky'omunda ekya akawunti, ID y'ekyuma, kkopi ya koodi ey'ekyama ey'essimu esibiddwa mu ngeri ey'oludda olumu, n'ennaku), okusazaamu kusobole okumalirizibwa mu ngeri ey'obukuumi era kulagibwe nti kwabaawo.

delete.kept.backups.en: {lead}: our database provider keeps daily backups for 7 days, so deleted information can stay in a backup for up to 7 days.
delete.kept.backups.text: {lead}: omugabi w'etterekero lyaffe atereka kkopi ez'okwekuuma eza buli lunaku okumala ennaku 7, n'olwekyo ebisaziddwamu biyinza okusigala mu kkopi ey'okwekuuma okutuuka ku nnaku 7.

delete.kept.support.en: {lead} about your request, for as long as we need them to deal with it.
delete.kept.support.text: {lead} ezikwata ku kusaba kwo, okumala ebbanga eryetaagisa okukukolako.

delete.kept.more.en: See our {privacy} for full details of how long we keep information and your other rights.
delete.kept.more.text: Okumanya ebisingawo ku bbanga lye tutereka ebikwata ku bantu n'eddembe lyo eddala, laba {privacy} yaffe.
